subject: general
question: India defeated which of the following countries, to clinch the bronze medal in the Women's Asia Cup Hockey Tournament, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** China.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **India beat China, 2-0 to win the bronze medal at the 2022 Women’s Hockey Asia Cup tournament.**
 
• The 2022 Women’s Hockey Asia Cup was the 10th volume of the quadrennial Women’s Hockey Asia Cup.
 
• The tournament was clasp from January 21 to 28, 2022 at the Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex in Muscat, Oman. 
 
• Japan beat South Korea 4-2 in the final to win their third prize at the Women’s Hockey Asia Cup tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​ Asia Cup Hockey 2022: **India wins a Bronze medal, beats Japan 1-0.**
 
• Hockey, men's Asia Cup 2022: Korea beat **Malaysia** for the record-expending 5th prize, and **India** win bronze.
